question: The marketing team _____ the new campaign before the director returned from Singapore.
explanation: Hành động xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ (returned) nên dùng quá khứ hoàn thành.

question: Ms. Tran asked her assistant to send the signed contract to _____ office by Friday.
explanation: Trước danh từ office cần tính từ sở hữu, nên chọn her.

question: The new software allows employees to submit expense reports more _____ than before.
explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ submit, nên chọn efficiently.

question: _____ the heavy rain, the outdoor product launch attracted more than two hundred guests.
explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ the heavy rain nên dùng giới từ Despite, không dùng liên từ Although.

question: All applications must be received _____ 5:00 P.M. on March 15 to be considered.
explanation: By chỉ thời hạn cuối cùng phải hoàn thành việc gì đó.

question: The consultant _____ recommendations were adopted by the board will visit the factory next week.
explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ recommendations và chỉ sự sở hữu của consultant, nên dùng whose.

question: Choose the word that best completes blank [1].
explanation: Đoạn văn nói về việc chuyển văn phòng sang địa chỉ mới, nên chọn relocation.

passage.title: Notice: Office Move
passage.content:
To all staff,

The [1] of our Hanoi office to the Lotus Tower will take place on June 3. Please pack your personal items by May 30. Moving crews will transport all equipment over the weekend, and the new office will open on Monday morning.

Facilities Department

question: What is the main purpose of the email?
options: To explain a delay in a delivery
explanation: Câu đầu tiên của email thông báo đơn hàng bị chậm do cảng đóng cửa vì bão.

passage.title: Email: Order 4471
passage.content:
From: Linh Pham, Customer Service
To: Mr. David Ross
Subject: Order 4471

Dear Mr. Ross,

We regret to inform you that your order of 40 office chairs will arrive later than planned because the port in Hai Phong closed for three days during the recent storm. The shipment should now reach your warehouse on August 12 instead of August 7.

To apologize for the inconvenience, we will refund the shipping fee. If the new date does not suit you, please call me at extension 215 and I will arrange a partial delivery from our Da Nang warehouse.

Sincerely,
Linh Pham

question: What is offered to Mr. Ross as compensation?
options: A discount on his next order
A refund of the shipping fee
explanation: Email viết rõ: we will refund the shipping fee.
